title: Exercise 3: Gate Calibration with allowedTools
description: Five commands launch Claude Code with --allowedTools for read_file and --disallowedTools for write_file and execute_command, then inside the session you ask it to read, create, and run a file to hit each gate behavior.

steps.description: The launch flags configure reads as auto-approved, writes and shell commands as gated. Inside the session, the three actions (read README.md, create hello.py, run it) each hit a different gate.
Line 3 shows the disallowed tools: write_file and execute_command both require approval while read_file passes silently.

steps.question: What three screenshots should you capture?
steps.answer: (a) a file read that passed silently, (b) a file write gate prompt, and (c) a shell command gate prompt
